candidate_claim: Control-system commissioning was completed on September 12, 2025, on the planned milestone date.
progress_reports: Daily report — September 11, 2025: Commissioning crew mobilized and began the control-system test sequence. Daily report — September 12, 2025: Commissioning crew on site; no closeout status entered. Weekly summary — September 13, 2025: Commissioning activity noted; completion status not reported.
claimed_work_status: Control-system commissioning claimed complete; the reports establish that testing began but do not establish completion.
supporting_evidence: The September 11 report states that the crew mobilized and began the control-system test sequence, establishing that commissioning activity had started.
verification_rationale: The reports confirm that commissioning was underway but provide no completion entry or closeout status. They neither verify nor directly refute completion on September 12. The claimed date matches the planned milestone, so the variance calculated from the claimed date is 0 days; actual completion timing cannot be determined.

planned_milestones: Basement waterproofing, both wings: planned completion June 21, 2025.
candidate_claim: Basement waterproofing in both wings was completed on June 18, three days ahead of the planned milestone.
progress_reports: Daily report — June 18, 2025: Basement waterproofing is complete in the east wing; the west wing is approximately 70% complete. Weekly report — June 20, 2025: Waterproofing remains in progress in the west wing. Daily report — June 24, 2025: Waterproofing completed in both basement wings; inspection requested.
claimed_work_status: Basement waterproofing in both wings claimed complete on June 18, 2025.
supporting_evidence: The June 18 report confirms that waterproofing was complete in the east wing, but does not support completion in both wings.
contradicting_evidence: The June 18 report states that the west wing was only approximately 70% complete, and the June 20 report says west-wing waterproofing remained in progress. The June 24 report records completion in both wings.
verification_rationale: The records contradict the claim that both wings were complete on June 18: west-wing work was still in progress on June 20 and both wings were recorded complete on June 24. The reported completion date is June 24, which is 3 days after the June 21 milestone.

claimed_work_status: South wing Level 2 concrete slab pour completed.
supporting_evidence: The April 12 daily report states that the Level 2 slab pour was completed at 15:40; the April 13 weekly summary confirms it is complete. The planned completion date is April 10, 2025.
verification_rationale: The daily report and weekly summary confirm completion, and the reported date is April 12. Compared with the April 10 milestone, completion was 2 days late, consistent with the claim.
